name: Deinterleave
description: The first clip comes apart like interlaced lines of data: its even rows slide up and its odd rows slide down into two half-height copies, each copy splits again into four, then eight; the copies flip over to the second clip, whose rows interleave back into one picture. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: stages
params.description: Number of splitting rounds: the picture ends up as 2, 4, 8 or 16 copies

params.name: gap
params.description: Color showing between the rows while they are apart
